title: Periphery (603)
problem: All three parts (always dodge, always crit, take 50% more damage) only check whether the player's side has the trait, and only apply to your creatures. There is no enemy version, so an enemy's Periphery does nothing.
notes: Community claim: Does nothing for the enemy team when an enemy has it. Evidence: bc_CreatureAttack L1535-L1536 @0x1406e429a; bc_EventDamage L5175-L5176 @0x140eb016b; L5844 @0x140ed38bb. Fix sketch: H: add matching enemy-side checks at the 3 sites. Or T: "Only works for the player." Triage 2026-10-26: All three parts only check the player's side; an enemy holder gets nothing. | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Your creatures always dodge attacks and deal critical damage, but take 50% more damage". Fix: H: add the enemy-side cases to the three Periphery sites (player side only today). vs bugged: neutral for the player (affects enemy holders). 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Give an ENEMY Periphery (e.g. Trait Launcher): that enemy always dodges your attacks, always crits, and takes 50% more damage. Your own Periphery unchanged.

release_notes.intended: Your creatures always dodge attacks and deal critical damage, but take 50% more damage.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, it only worked for the player's side; an enemy holder got nothing.
release_notes.fix: Now it works for whichever side holds it.
